verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation is a desktop operating system, not a hosted service or API product, so a downloadable OpenAPI-style spec is the wrong axis for this kind of product. The releases.json file is a machine-readable release-metadata feed, not a specification describing an API, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
